policy_description: Proposed+: one cone, one learned CAD-posterior bounded shortcut, a learned-direction CAD corridor, and a 95%-credible residual EIG search.  The promoted model owns high-level routing only.  This invocation was selected by the fixed paired M12 campaign; the private offset is consumed only by the pre-touchdown air transport and is never supplied to learned or CAD routing.

conical_phase_pose_tracking_qualificatio.rule: Only an independently measured, timestamp-aligned cone pose trace can make a clean sample an offline training candidate.  Command-propagated DirectServo pose rows are diagnostics only.

tooling_commissioning_gate.rule: Full-loop motion uses the field-proven predecessor commissioning level: 92 mm axial TCP, manual stationary near-hole start, WORLD-aligned fixture axes, fresh touchdown/capture local datum and 6 mm segmented insertion.  Missing physical IDs, payload/CoM/inertia, pivot and fixture metrology are disclosed but do not block this full-loop entry.  Sampling uses a separately disclosed operator-taught run-local centre and acquisition-only contract.

controller_load_handling.rule: The predecessor successfully used KST geometry-only tool registration plus same-run relative Bota baselines; strict Sunrise LoadData/readback attestation remains unqualified and is disclosed rather than treated as motion authority.
